dish.title: Black Bean Quesadillas
dish.name: Black Bean Quesadillas
dish.description: Black bean and cheese quesadillas, with the beans salted, garlicked, and finished with lime before they go in the tortilla.

recipe_version.title: Black Bean Quesadillas
recipe_version.description: Black bean and cheese quesadillas, with the beans salted, garlicked, and finished with lime before they go in the tortilla.
recipe_version.doneness: Tortillas golden and the cheese melted.

ingredients.name: black beans
ingredients.note: 15 oz, drained, rinsed, and lightly mashed.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: In the mashed beans. The cheese is salty too. 3 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (1 tsp). The same weight is 0.75 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 0.5 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Season the beans
steps.body: Mash the black beans with the ground cumin, garlic, lime juice, and Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Taste the mash and add a pinch more salt only if it still tastes flat next to the cheese.

steps.title: Fill and crisp
steps.body: Spread the beans and half the shredded cheese on the flour tortillas, top with the rest of the cheese, and fold. Cook in the neutral oil over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa.
